deep.title: DFM Mimir v1: An Open HRM Delivering Frontier Performance at 1B Parameters Using Only Permissible Post-Training Data
deep.summary: Current large language model development relies on massive, often non-permissible datasets, creating a high barrier for researchers committed to open-source and ethically sourced data. We introduce Mimir v1, a 1-billion-parameter language model based on the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) architecture, that is trained from scratch and delivers highly competitive performance for English and sets a new state of the art for Danish using only permissible post-training data. Trained on a mixture of 161 datasets, Mimir v1 outperforms the original HRM-Text 1B and competes with larger frontier models like Qwen 3.5 4B and Gemma 4 E2B, tested across 20 benchmarks for English, Math & Code and Danish. The model is available on the Hugging Face Hub: https://huggingface.co/danish-foundation-models/DFM-Mimir
deep.score_reason: 1B 参数 HRM 架构模型，仅用许可数据训练即达前沿性能，对低成本模型选型有实际参考。
deep.analysis:
这是一篇关于 DFM Mimir v1 模型的技术分析，它介绍了一个在严格数据合规约束下，用 10 亿参数达到前沿性能的开源分层推理模型。

它解决的核心痛点，是当前大模型研发对海量、且往往版权存疑或伦理上不可商用的“非许可数据”的深度依赖。这给那些坚持开源精神、追求数据来源完全合规的研究者与机构，筑起了极高的参与门槛。Mimir v1 的诞生，就是为了证明在完全不触碰这些灰色数据的前提下，仅依靠“许可数据”，小尺寸模型也能在多种语言和任务上具备与更大尺寸模型竞争的实力。

在技术流程与方法上，该模型有几点值得深挖。首先，它基于分层推理模型架构，这是一种试图将复杂问题拆解为多步推理过程的结构化设计，而非传统的单一前馈变换器堆叠。其次，模型是从零开始预训练的，而非基于现有模型微调，这保证了其数据管线的纯净性。最关键的在于其后训练阶段的数据策略：团队混合使用了 161 个数据集，全部为许可数据，并以此驱动模型在英语、数学与代码、以及丹麦语三个维度上进行能力对齐。从结果看，这种策略非常有效——Mimir v1 不仅超越了同尺寸的原始 HRM-Text 1B 模型，还在 20 项基准测试中展现出与 Qwen 3.5 4B、Gemma 4 E2B 这类参数量是其四倍以上的前沿模型相抗衡的性能，并在丹麦语任务上达到了新的最优水平。

对于 AI 应用岗的面试与实践，这条资讯提供了几个高价值的谈点。第一，它展示了“数据合规性”如何从法务需求转变为技术竞争力。在面试中，你可以结合这个案例，讨论在金融、医疗等强监管行业落地大模型时，如何设计完全基于许可数据的后训练流水线，避免潜在的版权与隐私风险。第二，它印证了小模型在特定垂直领域（如小语种、特定逻辑推理）通过精细的后训练，完全可以替代大模型，从而大幅降低线上推理成本与延迟，这是生产环境可用性的关键。第三，分层推理架构的落地，提示我们在设计 AI 应用时，可以将复杂任务显式地拆解为规划、执行、验证等子模块，用工程手段弥补模型尺寸的不足，这会是面试中展现你系统设计深度的好切入点。

deep.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B on Apple Silicon: Fixing Deployment Bugs and Decreasing Looped Transformer Memory Overhead
deep.summary: Nanbeige4.2-3B is a 3B-parameter agentic model built around a Looped Transformer (LT) that reuses one stack of layers for a second forward pass, adding effective depth without additional parameters. Evaluated on Apple Silicon (MPS), we identify five independent bugs which prevent the released checkpoint from running via Hugging Face transformers out of the box (including a silently-zeroed RoPE buffer and calls to removed transformers cache APIs). Furthermore, we show that fixing these bugs is still not sufficient for agentic tasks, due to the LT's layer-reuse strategy (which effectively doubles peak attention memory) used to achieve parameter efficiency. We thus introduce a chunked-prefill strategy which alleviates the incurred memory-capacity penalty, extending allowable context width by 2.7 times on 32~GiB shared memory. However, even with the reduced memory overhead, we show that patches are required to render Nanbeige4.2-3B usable; resolving both system prompt and MPS-native memory bugs finally allows reliable evaluation on standard MCP and tool-calling benchmarks. On a subset of MCPMark, the debugged model completes up to 30\% of real agentic tasks (up from the original's 0\%), while, on BFCL, it is near-perfect at single tool calls (yet fails the majority of multi-tool tests). We release the patched checkpoint, system prompt optimizer, and evaluation harnesses at https://github.com/johnhalloran321/Nanbeige4.2-3B-mps-fix.
deep.score_reason: 修复 Looped Transformer 在 Apple Silicon 上的部署 bug 并降低内存开销，直接解决生产部署问题，有代码细节。
deep.analysis:
这是一篇关于在 Apple Silicon 上部署 Nanbeige4.2-3B 模型并修复其部署缺陷的技术报告。Nanbeige4.2-3B 是一个 30 亿参数的智能体模型，其核心架构采用了 Looped Transformer（循环 Transformer，一种通过重复使用同一组层进行第二次前向传播来增加模型有效深度而不增加参数量的技术）。

该工作解决的核心痛点是：尽管模型在理论设计上通过参数复用实现了效率提升，但其发布的检查点在实际部署中完全无法运行，且即使修复了基础错误，模型在智能体任务上仍因内存瓶颈而不可用。具体而言，作者在 Apple Silicon 的 MPS 后端上发现了五个独立的缺陷，这些缺陷导致模型无法通过 Hugging Face transformers 库直接开箱即用。其中包括一个被静默置零的 RoPE（旋转位置编码，一种为注意力机制注入位置信息的方法）缓冲区，以及对已移除的 transformers 缓存 API 的调用。这些底层实现错误直接阻断了模型的初始推理。

技术流程的核心在于分两步解决可用性问题。第一步是修复上述五个代码缺陷，使模型能够执行基础推理。但作者发现，仅修复这些缺陷仍不足以支撑智能体任务，因为 Looped Transformer 的层复用策略在追求参数效率的同时，实际上将注意力机制的峰值内存占用翻倍，导致在 32GB 共享内存的 Apple Silicon 设备上上下文窗口严重受限。为此，作者引入了分块预填充策略，这是一种将长序列切分为多个块进行分步处理的技术，将允许的上下文宽度扩展了 2.7 倍。第二步是进一步解决系统提示词和 MPS 原生内存的缺陷，最终使模型能够在标准的 MCP 和工具调用基准测试上可靠运行。实验显示，调试后的模型在 MCPMark 子集上完成了高达 30% 的真实智能体任务，而原始版本完成率为 0%；在 BFCL 基准上，模型对单次工具调用近乎完美，但在多数多工具测试中仍然失败。

对 AI 应用岗而言，这篇工作的价值在于它揭示了从模型论文到生产可用的巨大鸿沟，这是面试中展示工程化思维的绝佳素材。首先，它强调了部署环境兼容性测试的重要性，五个缺陷中任何一个都足以让模型“零分”，这提醒我们在集成第三方模型时必须建立严格的验证流水线。其次，分块预填充策略是解决内存受限场景下长上下文推理的实用技巧，可以直接迁移到移动端或边缘设备的 AI 应用开发中。最后，模型在单工具调用上近乎完美却在多工具组合上失败的现象，是讨论智能体系统可靠性的典型切入点：它说明当前模型可能只是记住了单步操作模式，而非真正具备多步规划与推理能力，这直接关系到产品设计中如何设置任务粒度和兜底策略。面试中可以结合这些点，展现自己从模型选型、部署调试到性能优化和局限性评估的全链路思考。

deep.title: Second Thought: Reasoning in Parallel as LLM Agents Act and Observe
deep.summary: LLM agents in the ReAct paradigm alternate between reasoning, acting, and observing, but deliberate reasoning is confined to the Thought phase: while the agent serializes an action and waits for the environment, its reasoning is frozen. We identify this recurring interval for Action and Observation as a reasoning idle window and ask whether it can host additional reasoning in parallel that serves future turns. Therefore, we propose Second Thought, a training-free inference framework that forks four auxiliary branches the instant each Thought phase concludes, decodes them concurrently with the main loop, and merges the generated thoughts back when the environment observation arrives. In this way, Second Thought relocates the added reasoning off the main thread's sequential decoding path. Across three agentic benchmarks and three reasoning LLMs, Second Thought lowers the average turn count in all nine (model,benchmark) pairs and reduces main thread decoding in six of them by up to 43% (roughly 20% on average among those settings), while leaving it essentially unchanged in a seventh; Pass@1 shows no significant change in seven of nine pairs and the two significant differences are +12.4 and +10.2 points. Against a compute-matched control that forces an equivalent budget onto the main thread's own reasoning, it attains strictly higher Pass@1 with 1.3 to 3.2 less sequential decoding in all four settings where the control applies.
deep.score_reason: 提出在ReAct agent的Action/Observation阶段并行推理，直接改进agent效率，有工程落地价值
deep.analysis:
这是一篇关于 LLM Agent 推理框架优化的论文，提出了名为 Second Thought 的方法。它的核心思想是在 ReAct 范式（一种让大模型交替进行“思考-行动-观察”的智能体工作模式）中，利用 Agent 执行动作并等待环境返回观察结果的空闲时间，并行地进行额外的推理，从而在不增加主流程串行解码时间的前提下，提升推理质量和任务效率。

此前，ReAct 范式下的 LLM Agent 存在一个明显的效率痛点：当 Agent 生成一个动作（比如调用搜索 API）并等待环境返回观察结果时，其推理过程是完全冻结的。这个等待间隔被称为“推理空闲窗口”。传统的做法是让模型在这个窗口里干等，或者强行在主流程中塞入更长的推理链，但这会直接增加用户感知的延迟，因为主流程的每一步都是串行的。这种串行等待机制浪费了宝贵的计算资源，也限制了 Agent 在复杂任务中的表现。

Second Thought 的技术流程非常精巧，且完全不需要训练。它的工作方式是这样的：在每个思考阶段结束的瞬间，系统会分叉出四个辅助推理分支。这些分支与主流程（即执行动作和等待观察结果的过程）完全并行地运行，各自独立地生成后续的思考内容。当环境的观察结果最终返回时，系统会将主流程的观察结果与这些并行生成的辅助思考进行合并，然后一起送入模型，用于指导下一步的决策。这种设计的巧妙之处在于，它将额外的推理计算完全移出了主流程的串行解码路径。这意味着，虽然模型在后台做了更多的思考，但用户感知到的每一步响应延迟并没有增加。实验数据也证实了这一点：在三个智能体基准测试和三个推理模型上，Second Thought 在所有九个测试组合中都降低了完成任务所需的平均交互轮数，并且在其中六个组合中，将主流程的串行解码量最多降低了 43%，平均降低约 20%。更关键的是，在 Pass@1 准确率上，九个组合中有七个没有显著变化，另外两个甚至分别提升了 12.4 和 10.2 个百分点。与一个计算量匹配的对照组（将同等算力强行塞入主流程推理）相比，Second Thought 在所有可对比的设置中都取得了更高的 Pass@1 准确率，同时串行解码量减少了 1.3 到 3.2 倍。

对于 AI 应用岗的面试和实际生产环境，这篇论文的价值在于它提供了一个极具工程启发性的“零成本”优化思路。首先，它直击了 LLM 应用的核心矛盾：推理深度与响应延迟之间的权衡。在面试中，你可以借此展示你对 Agent 系统运行时特性的深刻理解，而不仅仅是会调用 API。你可以讨论“推理空闲窗口”这个概念，说明你懂得如何识别和利用系统中的空闲计算资源来提升整体智能，这是一种系统级的优化思维。其次，它的“无训练”特性意味着这个方案可以立即应用于任何现有的 ReAct Agent 系统，无需额外的模型微调成本，这对于追求快速迭代和上线的生产环境来说极具吸引力。最后，你可以引申到更广泛的架构设计讨论，比如这种“主-辅”并行推理的架构，本质上是一种推测性解码或异步思考模式，它如何与流式响应、任务取消、资源调度等工程问题结合，这能充分体现你从研究到落地的工程化能力。

mid.title: Claim-Level Reliability Assessment for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning
mid.summary: We propose claim-level falsification as a principle for test-time scaling and instantiate it through Claim-Level Reliability Assessment (CLR), a training-free framework that reallocates test-time compute from additional solution sampling to targeted verification. Since whole-trace evaluation often obscures decisive errors due to signal dilution from routine tokens, CLR condenses each reasoning trace into a compact set of decision-critical claims, thereby isolating its logical anchors. Furthermore, recognizing the inherent difficulty of generating entirely correct solutions under fixed model capabilities, CLR shifts the focus to semantic falsification. This approach exploits a fundamental asymmetry between solution construction and claim refutation. Constructing a valid solution requires a flawless reasoning path, whereas refuting an incorrect claim requires identifying only a single decisive flaw. This targeted search for negative evidence systematically compresses the survival space of high-confidence incorrect traces, effectively suppressing erroneous consensus via nonlinear reliability scoring. Across four LLMs and four reasoning benchmarks under matched budgets, CLR generally improves upon pass@1 and self-consistency. On GPT-OSS-20B/CMIMC25, for instance, CLR exceeds pass@1 by 27.15 percentage-points and raises self-consistency accuracy from 77.50\% to 82.19\% with 37.0\% fewer tokens.

mid.analysis: 我们提出了一种基于声明级证伪的测试时推理框架 CLR，它不依赖额外训练，通过将完整推理链压缩为一组决策关键声明，把算力从重复采样转向针对性验证。该方法利用“构造正确解需要完整无误路径，而推翻错误声明只需发现一处致命缺陷”的不对称性，通过非线性可靠性评分系统性地压缩高置信度错误解的生存空间。在四个大模型和四个推理基准上，CLR 在匹配预算下普遍优于 pass@1 和自一致性方法，例如在 GPT-OSS-20B 上准确率提升超过 27 个百分点，同时节省 37% 的 token 消耗。

paper.title: MobileMem: Learning from a Year of Mobile Experiences
paper.summary: The next generation of AI agents is increasingly moving beyond systems that answer isolated questions toward persistent personal assistants that can understand, remember, and continuously learn from users' experiences. Such assistants require long-term memory to accumulate and leverage user-specific experiences over time, yet existing benchmarks remain inadequate for realistic mobile settings, where experiences are heterogeneous, multimodal, evolving, and deeply personal. We introduce MobileMem, a benchmark and framework for studying on-device long-term memory, grounded in a year-scale collection of mobile experiences. MobileMem employs a knowledge-grounded synthesis pipeline to construct coherent and temporally consistent long-horizon trajectories from user-app sessions. It provides complementary text and multimodal settings covering multi-hop and temporal reasoning, knowledge updating, and implicit preference inference. Specifically, MobileMem enables agents to remember the past, understand the present, and adapt to the future. By modeling experiences rather than isolated facts, MobileMem moves memory beyond information retrieval toward experiential intelligence for continuous personal learning.

paper.title: Agents Catching Agents: Shortcut Cascades and Benchmark Gaming in Clinical Multi-Agent Systems
paper.summary: Clinical decision support is moving toward committees of language-model agents deliberating on a shared workspace. We ask whether such committees can be gamed by shortcuts, cues a benchmark rewards but a clinician would ignore. Across seven cohorts on six public datasets spanning text (MedQA-USMLE, MedMCQA, MIMIC-CXR reports), imaging (NIH ChestX-ray14, MIMIC-CXR-JPG, CheXpert) and tabular ICU records (SUPPORT2), Gemini committees resist these cues in isolation (flip 5-16%), yet a socially plausible shortcut spreads: when two peers assert the same wrong answer, the holdout under test adopts it in 38% of cases, as does a false "pre-screen" system flag, on both capability tiers. Of three oversight agents, a gate cannot separate adoption from honest agreement (false-positive rate 100%); a same-lineage judge reading only the transcript flags adoption on text (precision 100%, recall 93%) but collapses onto the gate in imaging; a referee that privately re-queries the holdout transfers to imaging (77-88% precision, 13-21% false-positive rate). Tripling a cue's visual salience does not move contagion, whereas a second peer voice raises it by half again. Gaming a hidden rubric is near-silent: only 1/10 text and 1/134 imaging drifters name the rubric they moved toward. What games a committee is social plausibility, and only a referee independent of self-report catches it. Code: https://github.com/criticaldata/benchmaxxing

paper.title: SimpleOPD: Simple Tokenizer-Agnostic On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning
paper.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a promising way to transfer reasoning capabilities from stronger teacher models, but applying it to long-context reasoning teachers and short-context students introduces practical challenges, including tokenizer mismatch, teacher-student distribution mismatch, response length explosion, and training instability. In this work, we study this setting by transferring proof-reasoning capabilities from the long-context reasoning model SU-01 to short-context student models. To handle tokenizer differences, we perform OPD in a shared text space and align only tokens that occupy identical text spans under the student and teacher tokenizers. To mitigate the problem of excessive generation length and frequent truncation, we introduce a student reference KL loss and mask the advantages of special termination tokens such as </think> and <|im_end|>. This strategy constrains the student from drifting excessively from its initial policy, thereby mitigating the teacher-student distribution mismatch problem and fostering steady length growth. Experiments on both same-family and different-family student models, including Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Intern-S2, GLM-4.7, Gemma-4, show consistent gains in mathematical reasoning, especially natural-language math proving. Notably, Intern-S2-Preview improves by 21.2 points on ProofBench, reaching 55.2 and surpassing Gemini-2.5-Pro. paper.title: Amplified Does Not Mean Predictive: Reasoning Behaviors in Thinking Models
paper.summary: Which reasoning behaviors are associated with correct answers in reasoning models, and does reasoning-oriented training amplify those behaviors? This distinction is important because reasoning-oriented training can make traces look more deliberative without amplifying the behaviors most tied to model correctness. We quantify this mismatch with Behavioral Lift, a metric that measures how much correctness changes when a behavior is present versus absent in a model's reasoning trace. Across 15 models and 6 benchmarks spanning text-only and vision-language reasoning, we annotate 15,282 traces with a taxonomy whose core behaviors are defined for both LLM and VLM traces. We find evidence for an Amplification-Lift Gap, in which thinking models strongly amplify self-correction, hypothesis testing, and uncertainty acknowledgment, while the highest-lift behaviors are confidence calibration, knowledge alignment, and self-awareness. Confidence calibration is among the strongest positive signals of correctness in both modalities, yet is barely amplified; uncertainty acknowledgment is amplified by 3--7times, yet is weakly or negatively associated with correctness. paper.title: Forecast Collapse in Time-Series Foundation Models
